title: Worldline instantons for nonperturbative particle production by space and time dependent gravitational fields
abstract: Develops a technique using worldline instantons to determine the momentum distribution of particles created by gravitational fields that vary across both space and time. Instantons are 'open' with complex middle section representing formation region and endpoints depicting asymptotic particle trajectories. Extends worldline instanton formalism from electromagnetic to gravitational pair production.
key_claims: Worldline instanton approach extended to gravitational particle production
Handles both space and time dependent gravitational fields
Open instantons with complex formation region
Sophisticated WKB approximation for complicated field configurations
